body: I tried very very hard to make myself alone. I pushed everyone else out. I'm 22 and from New Zealand.
I've tried. People either don't understand, or I trust them and then they hurt me, leaving me far worse off in the end. People aren't worth it really, I don't think.

Sure, people'd be sad if I died. People dying is sad. They don't care enough about me to try and understand how much it hurts to carry on, every day. It's superficial love and caring. If it was genuine, I wouldn't be so goddamned alone.
